svg.title: Run jobs while you are away
svg.desc: At 5 PM, an agent submits a batch of 100 jobs. An illustrated computer contains a pueue window with 92 waiting jobs and eight running slots. Job 1 has just finished and saved output, leaving one slot free while seven other jobs run with different progress. An arrow shows Job 9 moving automatically from the queue into that slot. The computer stays awake. At 9 AM, the agent reviews outputs, logs and a report distinguishing completed, failed and still-running jobs; the timeline is illustrative.
